strips.title: Thanksgiving with a thermometer — in real life

panels.head: Day before — ice bath
panels.text: Crushed ice, a little water, stir, probe in the middle. It should read about 32 °F; a few degrees off means a fresh battery or a trim.

panels.head: Roasting — three spots
panels.text: Innermost thigh, thickest breast and the wing, away from bone. USDA says 165 °F in all of them.

panels.head: Near done — move the probe
panels.text: One hot spot proves nothing. Re-check a second spot before you pull the bird.

panels.head: Carving — wipe, don't soak
panels.text: Wipe the probe clean and store it closed. Most of these are splash-proof, not dishwasher-proof.
